_note: water_level is a manual visual judgment per image (none/wheels/doors/windows/roof). demo marks the image used for the scripted demo case.
_demo_people_note: For the demo frame only, people not on/in a vehicle are dropped: YOLO also finds 3 bystanders on the far bank, which the single-frame shore heuristic would mislabel as in_water. The person on the roof is a real YOLO detection (no synthetic_person).

flood_01.jpg.note: Sedan in fast flash-flood current, water at the window line; woman sitting on the roof (real detection, no synthetic person).

flood_02.jpg.note: Same car seconds later; swift-water rescuer beside the car helping the woman off the roof.

flood_03.jpg.note: Same scene, wider shot; woman on the roof, crowd on the far bank.

flood_04.jpg.note: Red car floating in open floodwater, hood under, water at the windows.

flood_05.jpg.note: Cars floating in a flooded Houston street (Harvey), only roofs and upper windows above water.

flood_06.jpg.note: Elevated view of a parking lot under a carport, car submerged to the doors (Harvey).

flood_07.jpg.note: SUV in a flooded ditch, water around the wheels.

flood_08.jpg.note: Cars driving through a flooded street at dusk, water at the wheels.
